About the model

KROG 21-02. 166 patients; Cox model: 165 patients, 147 deaths. Adjusted for age ≥50, KPS ≥80, RT interval ≥12 months and prior salvage surgery.

Dose. Prescription-based EQD2, α/β = 10 Gy (survival) and 3 Gy (RN). Initial and repeat courses are summed without recovery correction or spatial dose accumulation.

Survival. Quadratic Cox model with a Breslow baseline. Pointwise 95% intervals from 200 bootstrap resamples. No external validation or calibration assessment; regimen differences are associations, not treatment effects.

RN. Grade ≥2: 2/87 below 114 Gy and 10/79 at or above 114 Gy EQD2₃. This exploratory threshold is not a safety limit. Group proportions do not account for follow-up duration or competing mortality.

Use. Research and education. Estimates are restricted to specified dose and fractionation ranges. No patient records are bundled or stored. Native device testing remains pending.
